blocks.text: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of NorthStar Locate (the "Service"), operated by Devren Consu Inc ("we", "us"). By using the Service, you agree to these Terms.
NorthStar Locate lets you request to view the current location of a family member or friend. A person's location is shown to you only after that person has received your request and approved it.
You must be at least 18 years old to use the Service. We do not knowingly allow use by anyone under 18.

items: You may only request the location of people you know, and only for the purpose of staying connected and safe.
You must not track, monitor, or locate anyone without their knowledge and approval.
The person you request can decline or withdraw consent at any time, and the Service will stop showing their location immediately.

blocks.text: You agree not to use the Service to stalk, harass, or surveil anyone, to circumvent a person's refusal or withdrawal of consent, or to break any law. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.

items: Plans: Monthly at $99.00 USD per month, or Yearly at $199.00 USD per year, plus any applicable taxes.

blocks.text: You can cancel at any time. After you cancel, your access continues until the end of the current paid period and you will not be charged again. Payments are non-refundable. See our Refund and Cancellation Policy.

We may update these Terms. Continued use after an update means you accept the new Terms.
Devren Consu Inc ("we", "us") operates NorthStar Locate. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.

items: Account information: your email address and phone number.
Phone numbers you enter to send location requests.
Current location: collected only from a person who has approved a request, and only while that approval is active.
Payment information is handled by our payment provider, Whop. We do not store full card details.

blocks.text: To operate the Service, send location requests, show an approved person's current location to the requester, process payments, prevent misuse, and respond to support requests.

items: We show current location only. We do not store location history.
Location is shared only after the person approves the request. They can withdraw approval at any time, and sharing stops immediately.

blocks.text: We do not sell personal information. We share information only with service providers needed to run the Service (such as payment processing and hosting), or when required by law.
We keep account information while your account is active. You can ask us to delete your account and associated data by emailing us.
We use reasonable safeguards to protect information, but no system is completely secure.
The Service is for people 18 and older. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18, and will delete it if we learn we have.
You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your information by emailing us.
We may update this policy and will change the date above when we do.

title: NorthStar Locate – Refund and Cancellation Policy

items: You can cancel your subscription at any time.
